Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The players stride out to the middle. Pathum Nissanka and Danushka Gunathilaka are the openers for Sri Lanka. Josh Hazlewood to start with the ball. Here we go...
... THE CHASE ...

Now then! The pitch is looking a good one to bat on but Sri Lanka need their batters to step up this time around. They were clinical with the ball in the first T20I as well but were let down by their batters. Australian bowlers would be confident of defending this total with Adam Zampa, Pat Cummins, Josh Hazlewood and Kane Richardson in their line up. Do join us to see how the chase unfolds.

Excellent death bowling by the visitors! Sri Lankan bowlers leaked runs upfront but just when Australia looked more dangerous, Nuwan Thushara got rid of Ben and scalped his maiden wicket in international cricket. After that, Wanindu Hasaranga also got a wicket and shifted the momentum towards them. The bowlers got timely wickets and tightened the screws on Australia. They were super at the death overs as well and would be the happier team heading into the break.

Australia again failed to deliver with the bat. Ben McDermott and Aaron Finch started off well and scored runs at a brisk pace but the former departed inside the Powerplay. Finch who was looking solid too departed later. Glenn Maxwell could not do much damage while Josh Inglis looked set for a good knock but fell in the 14th over. The partnership between Marcus Stoinis and Steven Smith also never got going but they have still managed to go past 160 this time.

Sri Lanka have replicated their bowling performance from the first match. Some excellent death bowling from the visitors and they have restricted the Aussies for a par total. No Australian batter could fire at the end. Matthew Wade did hit a couple of boundaries and helped his side go past 160. With a quality bowling attack, Australia would fancy their chances here.
Well bowled! A yorker, on off. Wade can only jam it out towards mid off for a single. 16 off the last over and Australia finish with 164/6!
SIX! First maximum of the night and it couldn't have come at a better time. Around off, Matthew Wade stays deep in his crease and launches it high and handsome over the long on fence for a biggie.
Full and wide, this is squeezed through covers for a couple. Good running.

FOUR! Just short but maybe Wanindu Hasaranga should have looked to save the boundary at this stage. Fullish, going across off and Wade heaves it aerially towards the square leg fence. Hasaranga runs to his left and dives in to take the catch but the ball eludes him and bounces over the ropes.

How did Cummins get it over there? Another slower one, on the pads. Pat Cummins is set up to swing across but has to check his shot in the end. The ball pops up off the splice of the bat and goes over the keeper's head. The batters run three before the ball is cut off.
A slower yorker, very close to off stump. Pat Cummins clears the front leg and looks to swipe across the line but is completely undone by the lack of pace.
Length this time, around off. Cummins mistimes the loft over extra cover and picks up a single. What a penultimate over from Chameera, just 3 runs and a couple of wickets off it.
No hat-trick! Full and wide, this is slashed away behind point for a couple.
Pat Cummins walks out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT! Two in two for Dushmantha Chameera and he's on a hat-trick! Very smart bowling from Chameera. Short of a good length, dragged wider. Marcus Stoinis tries to fetch it and pull it across but only manges to get a top edge on it. The ball loops up and goes straight into the hands of Maheesh Theekshana at short third man. He makes no mistake and both set batters are now dismissed.
Commentary.Howout: c Maheesh Theekshana b Dushmantha Chameera

Commentary.Commentary: The new batter in is Matthew Wade.

OUT! TAKEN! This has been a brilliant fightback by Sri Lanka in the last couple of overs and they are rewarded with a wicket as well. A slower length ball, well outside off. Steven Smith stays leg side and reaches out. He throws everything at it but only manges to lift it towards the extra cover fence. Danushka Gunathilaka settles under it and takes a simple catch. Smith's hot and cold inning comes to an end.
Commentary.Howout: c Danushka Gunathilaka b Dushmantha Chameera

Commentary.Commentary: Brilliant! The Lankan pacers are keeping slower and dragging it wider. This is fairly wide of off and Steven Smith just can't quite reach it to turn it on the leg side. A dot ball.
Slower delivery, dragged outside off. Stoinis fetches and heaves it onto the leg side for a single.
Another slower length ball, outside off. Stoinis has to check his shot and just chips it down to long off for a single. Just 6 runs off it.
A length ball, outside off. This is chopped towards covers for one.
WIDE! Good thinking again, Karunaratne just drags the slower ball a bit too wide.
Excellent over so far from Karunaratne. A slower short ball, on off. Stoinis mistimes the pull through mid-wicket for a single.
On off, this is pushed back to the bowler.
WIDE! Full and wide, a bit too wide though.
Beaten! It's a bit fuller this time, outside off and curves away after pitching. Marcus Stoinis throws the kitchen sink at it but misses the ball by a mile.

Nicely bowled! Chamika Karunaratne takes all the pace off the ball and bowls it outside off. Stoinis waits and waits and looks to go big downtown. The ball though comes off the outside edge and falls well short of the keeper.
WIDE! Well, Karunaratne gets this one completely wrong. An attempted slower wide one, this is spilled way beyond the tramline.
Chamika Karunaratne (3-0-22-0) to bowl out.
Around off, pushed out onto the off side for a single. 11 off the over.

FOUR! Could that be called a dropped catch? Right in the slot, on off. Just a short-arm jab from Marcus Stoinis and the ball just rockets off his bat and goes just over the top of the fielder at mid off. The fielder is beaten for pace as he tries to leap up and take the catch. Second boundary of the over.
Slower this time and pushed even wider. Smith reaches out and taps it through point for a single.
FOUR! Pure timing from Steven Smith! A length ball, slightly wide of off. Smith makes a bit of room and smacks it through cover-point for a boundary.
Full, on off. This is drilled towards mid off for a quick single.
Great deception from Chameera. A slower length ball, around off. Marcus Stoinis looks to drive on the up but the ball darts away after pitching and Stoinis is left bamboozled.
Dushmantha Chameera (2-0-15-0) comes back on.
Quicker, around 100 kph and fired into the pads. Stoinis stays deep and bunts it out on the leg side for a single.
On off, this is pushed through cover-point for one more.
Easy two! A loopy delivery, around off. Smith waits for it and drives it through wide mid on for a couple.
Quicker again, very full and on off. Stoinis works it through mid on for a run.
Short, on off. Smith uses his feet and flicks it towards square leg for a single.
Quicker and flatter, on off. Smith can't get it away on the leg side.
Wanindu Hasaranga is done with his spell. Maheesh Theekshana (3-0-25-1) comes in to replace him and finish his spell as well.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Length ball, outside off. Marcus Stoinis again sees the width and has a slash at it. The ball races away to the deep point fence in a flash.
Good-length ball, outside off. Marcus Stoinis drives it straight to the point fielder this time.
On a good length, outside off. Marcus Stoinis punches it but straight to cover.
FOUR! Marcus Stoinis opens his account in style! Width offered, outside off. Marcus Stoinis hangs back and pounces on it. He cuts it hard behind point for a boundary.
Slower ball, full and outside off. Steven Smith guides it to backward point for a single. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
On a good length, outside off. Steven Smith steers it to point.
Chamika Karunaratne (2-0-13-0) is back on.
Loopy ball, on off. Marcus Stoinis knocks it back to the bowler.
Marcus Stoinis is in at number 6.

OUT! TAKEN! It's that man again, Wanindu Hasaranga! He gets his second wicket. Bowls a googly, shorter and on off. Josh Inglis makes room and looks to drive it uppishly but fails to get enough bat and goes towards covers. Dasun Shanaka dives forward and takes the catch just above the turf. Josh Inglis was looking good but has to depart now.
Commentary.Howout: c Dasun Shanaka b Wanindu Hasaranga

Commentary.Commentary: Full and on the pads, Steven Smith clips it to deep square leg for a run.
On middle, clipped to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Two again! Loopy ball, on middle. Josh Inglis rocks back and works it to long on for another brace.
Short and on middle, Josh Inglis makes room and punches it to sweeper cover for a couple of runs.
Wanindu Hasaranga (3-0-27-1) comes back in to finish his spell.
A yorker, on middle. Josh Inglis clears his front leg and digs it out to mid-wicket. He crosses ends.
Another slower ball, on the pads. Josh Inglis tries to flick it away but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Back of a length, on off. Steven Smith nudges it to mid-wicket for a run.
Slower delivery, outside off. Josh Inglis didn't read that one and spoons it towards point. It goes just past the leaping point fielder for a single.
Outside off, Josh Inglis clips it to mid-wicket for a brace. Good running!

Back of a length, nipping back in, on middle. Steven Smith could not get any bat on it and gets hit near the ribs. The ball rolls to the off side. Josh Inglis calls for a single but Steven Smith sends him back. The fielder has a shy at the bowlre's end but misses and now the batters get a leg bye off overthrows.
Dushmantha Chameera (1-0-10-0) is back on.
Floats it up, on middle. Steven Smith hangs back and nudges it on the leg side for a single. 100 up for Australia!
Steven Smith is the new man in.

The keeper, Dinesh Chandimal seems interested and Dasun Shanaka does go for the review for a caught behind decision. Well, it is Maxwell who is on strike, so they had to go for it. The third umpire checks the replays and seems that the ball did come off something. UltraEdge confirms that the ball just came off the gloves and what an excellent review from Sri Lanka. They have got their man, OUT!

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Loopy ball, outside off. Glenn Maxwell goes down on one knee and looks to reverse sweep. He misses and Dinesh Chandimal pouches the ball. He is very confident as he thinks there was something on it and appeals for a caught behind. The umpire says no. Dasun Shanaka opts for the review. And guess what? UltraEdge has picked up a spike as it shows the ball came off the gloves. The original decision will be reversed and Sri Lanka retain their review as well. Glenn Maxwell is not happy and shakes his head walking back to the pavilion.
Commentary.Howout: c Dinesh Chandimal b Maheesh Theekshana

Commentary.Commentary: Flatter, on the pads. Josh Inglis tucks it to mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! On off, Josh Inglis lifts it over covers for a boundary.

What just happened there? That was a flatter delivery, on off. Glenn Maxwell cuts it to point. He starts running but then stops and says no. Josh Inglis however, is already halfway down the pitch and ultimately, both the batters are at the same end. The fielder throws the ball to Dinesh Chandimal but he fails to collect the ball. That allows Glenn Maxwell enough time to get to the other end. A big mix-up and a huge opportunity for Sri Lanka but they have made a mess out of it.
Drops it short, outside off. Josh Inglis slashes it to deep cover for one.
Maheesh Theekshana (2-0-17-0) is back into the attack.
Touch fuller, slower one, on middle. Josh Inglis looks to flick. The ball goes off the outside edge to the off side for a run.
Full again, on the pads. Josh Inglis flicks it behind square on the leg side. The fielder in the deep runs to his right and slides to stop the ball. Keeps it down to a couple.
Fuller, on the pads. Glenn Maxwell clips it to short fine leg. Maheesh Theekshana has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
Back of a length, outside off. Josh Inglis steers it to sweeper cover for a single.
On a good length, much quicker, on middle. Josh Inglis is taken aback by the pace and he manages it clip it to deep square leg for a brace.
WIDE! A wayward delivery way down the leg side. Josh Inglis leaves it alone. Wided.
FOUR! Consecutive boundaries for Australia! Full and outside off, Josh Inglis drives it uppishly past mid off for a boundary. Just extended his arms there and gets the desired result.

FOUR! Glenn Maxwell seems to be getting the better of Wanindu Hasaranga tonight. Just a bit short and there's width on offer as well. Maxwell rocks back and cuts it hard, just behind point and into the fence.
On a length, on off and turning away a bit. Inglis hangs back and turns it through mid on for a run.
A touch shorter, around middle and leg. Maxwell works it off the back foot, behind square for a single.
On off, blocked out.
The wrong 'un, turning into the pads. Maxwell looks to tuck it leg side but gets an inside edge onto the pads.

FOUR! The bowler will be disappointed with that fielding effort. Flatter one, on the pads. Glenn Maxwell goes deep in his crease, swats it away behind square on the leg side. The fielder over there makes a mess of it and Maxwell gets a boundary.
A low full toss, sliding onto the pads. Maxwell looks to flick it over backward square leg but gets an inside edge towards mid-wicket. The batters get one.
A length ball, on off. This is whipped away off the inner half of the bat down to long on for a single.
FOUR! Overpitched and punished! On off, Josh Inglis leans into the straight drive and absolutely drills it back past the bowler to pick up a boundary.
Length, on off. Maxwell strokes it through covers for one more.

Nicely bowled. A slower ball, bowled into the pitch and this one seams away after pitching. As Inglis looks to defend the ball just pops up and Inglis does well to keep it down on the off side. Single taken.
Fullish delivery, on off. Maxwell punches it back towards the bowler who spills it and the batters scamper through for one. The boundaries have dried up a bit here.
Flatter, on the pads. This is clipped away through square leg for a run.
Glenn Maxwell is the new batsman in.

OUT! STUMPED! A canny change of pace and Aaron Finch is left bamboozled! Finch runs down the track and Wanindu Hasaranga just slows it up, bowls it shorter and on off. Finch is beaten in flight and this one turns in a bit again. Finch runs past the ball and Dinesh Chandimal whips off the bails in a flash. Top bowling from Hasaranga and the Aussie skipper departs.
Commentary.Howout: st Dinesh Chandimal b Wanindu Hasaranga

Commentary.Commentary: Loppy delivery, on off. Finch pushes it to mid on.
Here comes the googly again. Spinning into middle and leg, Inglis stays deep and heaves it with the spin towards deep mid-wicket. Single taken.
Flatter, on off. Finch looks to reverse sweep but mistimes it towards cover-point for a run.
Good running! Very full, on off. Finch wrists it through mid-wicket and pushes hard for two. He gets it with ease.
Length this time, outside off. Finch presses forward and nudges it down towards third man for a single.
On middle, this is tucked away onto the leg side for one.
Karunaratne looks absolutely fired up. A bumper, around off. At a good height and this one zips through. Inglis looks to fetch and hook but is well beaten.

Ooh, a bit of fire! Full and straight, Inglis pushes it back to the bowler. Chamika Karunaratne picks it up and in a flash throws it back towards the batter trying to be a bit aggressive. The umpire has a chat with him as well in order to keep things calm.
Back of a length, around off. This is punched off the back foot towards cover.
A length ball, around off. Inglis stands tall and drives it through the cover region for a couple.
Chamika Karunaratne is brought into the attack now.

Sri Lanka have opted a review for an LBW. UltraEdge shows no bat involved. Ball Tracker shows that the ball is pitching outside off, the impact is umpire's call and it is wickets hitting. The original decision stands. Sri Lanka retain their review.

NOT OUT! Umpire's call again and Sri Lanka once again getting close. This is another googly, tossed up a lot fuller and outside off. Aaron Finch strides out and tries to get inside the line of the ball to paddle it away. He misses and gets rapped on the pads. Wanindu Hasaranga seems certain he has got his man but the umpire remains unmoved. Everything seems fine but Ball Tracker confirms that the impact is umpire's call. Finch with another close shave. At the end of the Powerplay, Australia are 52/1!
On a length, on middle. Inglis hops on the back foot and works it on the leg side for a single. 12 already off the over with one ball still to go.
Flighted this time, around leg. Inglis flicks it through square leg and picks up an easy couple.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries for Inglis. A touch shorter, around off. Inglis rocks back and cuts it hard into the point fence.
FOUR! Too full and outside off. Josh Inglis leans in and just caresses it through extra cover for a boundary.
Hasaranga starts off with a googly. On off and spinning in. Finch backs away and chops it towards covers for a quick single.
Wanindu Hasaranga is introduced into the attack now.
A quick single! On middle, Aaron Finch drops it with soft hands to the leg side for a single.
Short and on off again. Aaron Finch looks to cut but mistimes and chops it back onto the deck.
Short and on off, tucked to mid-wicket for a single.
Quicker delivery, on off. Josh Inglis looks to cut but chops it back to the bowler off the inner half.
Floats it up, on off. Aaron Finch taps it towards covers for a single.
FOUR! Too wide and too short, outside off. Aaron Finch hangs back and cuts it past point for a boundary. You can't bowl there to Aaron Finch.
Josh Inglis is in at number 3.

OUT! TAKEN! Nuwan Thushara bags his first international wicket and gets rid of the big fish. It is Ben McDermott who will have to depart. Nuwan Thushara bowls it full and outside off. Ben McDermott decides to go downtown but didn't get enough elevation on that one. Hits it towards long on where Wanindu Hasaranga takes a good catch near his head. Australia lose their first wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Wanindu Hasaranga b Nuwan Thushara

Commentary.Commentary: Back of a length, on middle. Aaron Finch hops and tucks it on the leg side for a single.
FOUR! Shot! Length ball, outside off. Aaron Finch picks that one and dispatches it away towards the vacant deep mid-wicket region for a boundary.
On the pads, Ben McDermott whips it away to deep square leg. Only for a single though.

NOT OUT! Full, on middle and leg. Aaron Finch mistimes his drive to mid off and sets off for a quick single. The fielder scores a direct hit at the bowler's end and the umpire takes it upstairs. Replay shows that Aaron Finch made it back to the crease with a dive.

Is that a Run-Out? A bullet of a throw from Wanindu Hasaranga at the bowler's end and the stumps are shattered. The umpire has gone upstairs and the replay shows that the dive that Finch put in, saved him. Living dangerously at the moment the Aussie skipper.
On a good length, outside off. Aaron Finch chops it towards covers.

Dasun Shanaka has gone for the review for an LBW decision. The third umpire checks the replay and he is certain that there's no bat involved. Finch did move a long way across but Ball Tracker shows that the ball was just clipping the leg stump. Finch survives on umpire's call. NOT OUT!

NOT OUT! Flatter ball, on off, turning in. Aaron Finch shimmies down and looks to work it on the leg side but misses. He gets pinged on the pads. Loud shout from the bowler for an lbw but the umpire says no. The batters take a leg bye as the ball rolls to the leg side. Meanwhile, Dasun Shanaka opts for a review. UltraEdge show no bat involved. Ball Tracker shows that the ball was hitting the leg stump but it was umpire's call on wickets hitting. Sri Lanka retain their review though.
FOUR! Finch gets going as well! Floats it up, on leg. Aaron Finch makes room, waits for the ball to come and steers it past point for a boundary.
Flighted delivery, full and on off. Ben McDermott looks to sweep. The ball goes off the inside edge to fine leg for a run.

FOUR! Just beats the mid off fielder! Ben McDermott makes room and Maheesh Theekshana bowls it full and on leg. Ben McDermott lifts it past the diving mid off fielder for a boundary. Good power on that shot!
Loopy ball, outside off. Ben McDermott pats it back to the bowler.
Full and on off, Aaron Finch nudges it to mid-wicket for a single.
A change in the bowling straight away. Maheesh Theekshana is on now.
Slower delivery, outside off, at 116.8 kph. Ben McDermott slices it over covers. He comes back for the second run and gets it comfortably. A good over from the debutant, just 5 runs from it.
Full again, nipping away, on off. Ben McDermott prods and drives it to mid on. He calls for a single but quickly decides against it.
Late swing there! Touch fuller, outside off. Ben McDermott pushes it towards covers.
Outside off, on a length. Ben McDermott guides it to point.

Uppish but safe! Length ball, outside off, nipping away. Aaron Finch looks to drive it on the up but drives it uppishly towards covers. It goes just past the diving cover fielder and the batters get three runs. Finch is off the mark as well.
Swing straightaway! Fuller, on off, swinging away. Aaron Finch defends it back to the bowler.
Nuwan Thushara, on debut to share the new ball with Chameera.
On a length, outside off. Ben McDermott lets this one go. A good positive start from Australia. 10 runs from the first over.

FOUR! This is even better! Ben McDermott is looking very confident and is carrying his form from the last match. Length ball, outside off. Ben McDermott creams his drive on the off side and it races away to the fence.
FOUR! Lovely punch! First boundary of the innings! On a good length, on off. Ben McDermott hops and punches it through covers. Times it very well and gets a boundary.
Drags his length back a little, on middle. Ben McDermott stands up on his toes and knocks it back to the bowler.

Australia and Ben McDermott are underway! Good-length ball, outside off, with a bit of away movement. Ben McDermott looks to punch. The ball goes off the outside edge to third man for a couple of runs.
Dushmantha Chameera starts with a good-length ball, on off. Ben McDermott keeps his eyes on the ball and defends it to the off side.

We are ready for play! The Lankan players stroll out to the middle and they are followed by the Aussie openers, Ben McDermott and Aaron Finch. Dushmantha Chameera is ready to steam in with the new ball. Let's play...

Sri Lanka (Playing XI) - Danushka Gunathilaka, Pathum Nissanka, Charith Asalanka, Avishka Fernando, Dinesh Chandimal (WK), Dasun Shanaka (C), Chamika Karunaratne, Wanindu Hasaranga, Dushmantha Chameera, Maheesh Theekshana, Nuwan Thushara (On debut) (In place of Binura Fernando).

Australia (Playing XI) - Aaron Finch (C), Ben McDermott, Josh Inglis, Steven Smith, Glenn Maxwell, Marcus Stoinis, Matthew Wade (WK), Pat Cummins, Kane Richardson (In place of Mitchell Starc), Adam Zampa, Josh Hazlewood.
TOSS - Up goes the coin and lands in the favor of Sri Lanka. They have elected to BOWL first.

Sri Lanka bowlers are doing their job well and would want their batters to step up. They need to put a better performance in this match and need to fire together as a unit to bounce back. Accelerating while not losing wickets at regular intervals will be their main area of focus. They will hope that the bowling department can replicate the performance of the first match. Will Australia get another win? Or will Sri Lanka put up a show and level the series? We shall find out. Stay tuned for toss and team news.

Australia won the first T20I quite convincingly. They would be high on confidence but would want their batters to perform better. They are a well-balanced side and the T20 World champions have the winning momentum behind them as well. Their batting might be a little bit of concern but they are a champion side and would be backing themselves to come up stronger with the willow. They would look to further increase their lead and go 2-0 up in this encounter.

Hello folks! Welcome to the coverage of the second T20I between Australia and Sri Lanka. The Aussies are already 1-0 up in the five-match series and would look to seal another win. While Sri Lanka would eye a better performance and try to level the series.
... MATCH DAY ...
